During his lone competitive outing, Joakim approached the demanding formats with an understated intensity. While the ultimate distinction of hoisting the coveted Hector Trophée with a partner or claiming the prestigious individual Victor Trophy remained beyond his reach, his play was characterized by a diligent focus and a keen appreciation for the strategic nuances of the game. He was known for a thoughtful approach, carefully considering each shot and executing with precise intent, revealing a player who valued meticulous execution.

Following his solitary competitive venture, Joakim has since been widely understood to have stepped away from competitive Hector events. Therefore, it comes as no surprise that he will not be among the distinguished field for the upcoming Hector Trophée 2026. His brief yet impactful contribution to the tournament's narrative remains a point of interest, leaving a unique, concise legacy in its esteemed history.
